newsitem.title: USA: Tosco confirms crude unit to be shut in July.
newsitem.headline: Tosco confirms crude unit to be shut in July.

text.p: Tosco Corp said on Monday its 250,000 barrel per day (bpd) crude unit at its Bayway refinery will be shut for maintenance in late July.
"The amount of time the unit will be shut has not been determined, but it will be for a period of weeks," said a Tosco official that requested anonymity.

Previously, a source familiar with Tosco operations said the maintenance was unplanned, but the Tosco official said maintenance at the Linden, N.J.-based refinery was indeed planned although Tosco was still determining what kind of maintenance the unit will need.
The crude unit had been running at about 225,000 bpd.
The refinery houses the world's largest catalytic cracker that has earned it the moniker of "Gasoline Machine."
